## About Me

### What I'm Looking For
Right now I want to be part of a team and get more experience with building computer systems. I'm flexible with whatever the tech stack includes, and I want to learn new things as well as contribute what I already have.

### Long-Term Goal
My main goal is to write and maintain quality code that makes a difference. I don't aspire to a role that is more management than it is coding, but I do want to be a dependable, senior-level programmer that can take charge of major aspects of a project.
